slides.h: 5 signs you are [[the anime friend]] of the group.
slides.dek: A diagnostic. No cure is currently available.

slides.label: Sign 01
body: 'It gets good in episode 8' has left your mouth unironically. You keep a starter list for every personality type in your contacts, and you have deployed it.

slides.label: Sign 02
slides.h: A soundtrack in public [[stops you cold]].
body: A train station jingle, a cafe playlist, one violin note. Your friends have watched you leave a conversation mid-sentence to identify it.

slides.label: Sign 03
body: Not memes. Frames. You screenshot dialogue the way other people bookmark quotes, and you will never delete a single one.

slides.label: Sign 04
slides.h: You defend a show harder than your own decisions.
body: Someone called your favorite mid at a party once. Your friends still bring up what happened next. You maintain you were right.

slides.label: Sign 05
slides.h: The group already [[assigned you the role]].
body: Nobody asks whether you watch anime anymore. They just forward clips captioned 'this is you.' It is you.

slides.body: Send this to your group's anime friend. If nobody comes to mind, it's you.
